original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: On the selected width-73 word, enumerate every length-three consecutive ADD window in A or B that uses one unchanged source value for three distinct destinations, leaves the source frame unchanged, and has at least two positive target-frame climbs. Test the hypothetical C3 contract that replaces those target climbs by one tagged child of their summed rank.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card is broad. The first candidate—holding a source frame while it climbs—had no positive source-climb windows. One evidence-driven pivot selects the output-side C3 fanout: the source remains arbitrary and unchanged, and three distinct target lanes share one source. This differs from PR1756’s abstract cache control and PR1764’s two-lane same-gate boundary by using exact three-gate windows in the pinned selected word.
bottleneck_link: The selected local profile has 2,412 rank-one children. A C3 child replacing target ranks t1,t2,t3 by R=t1+t2+t3 preserves rank mass and lowers the q-moment for q=1-a in (0,1). The exact maximal non-overlapping schedule only raises the fixed-word ceiling 0.9066%, below the catalogue 5% acceptance margin, even with zero added adapter or hosting cost.
stop_rule: Replay the pinned selected word once, enumerate all qualifying length-three windows, and use exact weighted interval scheduling with upper bounds on each moment saving. Stop if the best possible profile remains above moment one at 1.05 times the baseline ceiling. Do not broaden to nonconsecutive windows, different arities, other words, or a physical C3 implementation in this cycle.
evidence: The selected word pins to decompressed SHA-256 c2b294300760e1fd6eeab8c22c4d13e4633dca40e52cac8da0d68163a76e3ca8; its exact report profile is {1:2412,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}. The scan covers all 3,451 A and 1,846 B operations. It finds 32 raw C3 windows (A:2, B:30); exact maximum-weight non-overlap scheduling selects 25 (A:2, B:23), yielding profile {1:2382,2:421,3:416,4:124,5:82,8:8,9:8,12:6}, mass 5,586. Its exact ceiling is 0.00170537534084, a 0.9065527351% gain. A certified upper bound on savings proves every non-overlapping C3 schedule in this domain still has moment greater than one at a=1.05 times the baseline ceiling; the lower margin is 0.0001991092063972. Added adapters, copies, hosting, restoration or precision costs are all granted zero. This is a scoped negative for the stated C3 family, not an impossibility result for other schedules.
